idea-plugin.name: Fold to Defaults
idea-plugin.description:
Adds the Fold to Defaults editor action: it resets the folding of the current file to the state a file gets on first open according to Settings | Editor | General | Code Folding, discarding manual expand/collapse changes.

Find it in Code | Folding and in the editor context menu under Folding. No shortcut is assigned by default; bind one in Settings | Keymap.

action.description: Reset folding of the current file to the defaults from Settings | Editor | General | Code Folding
